jobs.title: Audio Technician Studio & MCR MySports 40%
jobs.description:
Bei Sunrise denken wir grösser, gehen weiter und schaffen Neues. Für uns bedeutet Arbeitskultur: gemeinsam Grosses schaffen. Hier treffen Respekt und frische Ideen auf echtes Teamwork – jede Stimme zählt, jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, Neues zu wagen und ständig zu wachsen. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte.

Als Audio Technician im Studio & MCR bei MySports bist du für die reibungslose technische Umsetzung von Audio- und Broadcast-Produktionen verantwortlich. Du sorgst dafür, dass im Studio alles perfekt läuft, überwachst und schaltest Signale im Master Control Room und stellst eine hohe Audioqualität sicher. Mit deinem technischen Know-how, Blick fürs Detail und Interesse an Eishockey trägst du entscheidend zu einem professionellen On-Air-Erlebnis bei. DEINE CHALLENGE:

- Du bist zuständig für den störungsfreien Sendebetrieb im Studio, MCR und Playout bei MySports, inklusive Planung und Bereitstellung von Audio- und Intercomverbindungen
- Du erstellst das Setup und bedienst den Lawo-Audiomischer nach tagesaktuellen Bedürfnissen
- Du mischst den Ton der Studioproduktion sowie der Kommentatoren auf den Einzelspielkanälen
- Du unterstützt die Postproduktion (Schnitt und ENG) bei audiotechnischen Fragen
- Du berätst die Redaktion und Produktionsverantwortlichen bei audiotechnischen Fragen
- Du überwachst die Qualitätsstandards in der Audio-Broadcast-Umgebung und stellst diese sicher

DEINE SKILLS:

- Abgeschlossene technische Grundausbildung als Multimediaelektroniker, Mediamatiker, Elektroniker oder Informatiker
- Weiterbildung zum Tontechniker und/oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Broadcasttechnologien mit Schwerpunkt Audio- und Netzwerktechnik
- Fundiertes technisches Verständnis von Audio-Broadcast-Systemen, Netzwerktechnologien und Medientechnik, insbesondere von IP-Technologien im Audiobereich
- Spass an der Arbeit in einem dynamischen, innovativen Unternehmen mit Start-up-Flair sowie Begeisterung für Sport, insbesondere Eishockey
- Organisationstalent, Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit
- Selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Problemlösungskompetenz
- Bereitschaft für regelmässige Abend- und Wochenendeinsätze
- Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französisch von Vorteil

Bei Sunrise arbeitest du in einem dynamischen und multinationalen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört, Perspektiven geteilt und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Grosses.

Sunrise ist Partner von «Advance Gender Equality in Business», Träger des Schweizer LGBTI-Labels und mit «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» für die gleiche Bezahlung gleichwertiger Arbeit für alle zertifiziert.

Bist du bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann werde Teil des Teams und gestalte aktiv unsere Zukunft!

#ChallengersWanted

jobs.title: Senior TechLead - Contact Center Platforms 80-100%
jobs.description:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

Join our IT Customer Relation Platforms team and take the lead in shaping the future of Sunrise’s Contact Center platforms. As a Senior Tech Lead, you will drive innovation and ensure seamless customer interactions powered by cutting-edge CCaaS technologies. You will work at the intersection of technology, business, and operations, making a direct impact on customer experience. A key highlight: you will own a mission-critical platform used every day to serve thousands of customers.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Own and lead the Contact Center, Chatbot, Voicebot platforms, including architecture, roadmap, and continuous improvements
- Design and implement API integrations with internal systems and third-party applications
- Plan and execute releases, rollouts, and major platform changes ensuring stability and performance
- Monitor platform health proactively and ensure high availability and operational excellence
- Govern projects and change requests, including cost and timeline reviews
- Act as the main escalation point between internal teams and external partners (e.g., external partners, platform providers)
- Lead and support the team, ensuring efficient incident handling and SLA adherence

YOUR SKILLS:

- Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
- Proven experience in managing and operating contact center platforms (Sprinklr environments preferred)
- Strong knowledge of API integration, system architecture, and enterprise IT landscapes
- Experience in project governance, vendor management, and delivery oversight
- Familiarity with IT service management tools (e.g., Remedy, Octane) and incident processes
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business teams
- Fluent in English (spoken and written); German is an advantage

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together.

Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value.

Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future!

#ChallengersWanted

jobs.title: P2P Desk Manager 80-100%
jobs.description:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

Sunrise is transforming its Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) landscape through the P2P Optimisation Programme. A central pillar of this programme is the Sunrise Buying Desk – a two-location, tiered support model designed to deliver consistent, expert P2P service across every business unit.

As P2P Desk Manager, you lead the Zurich function. You are not a transaction processor – you are the operational authority who resolves what automated and first-line support cannot, closes systemic gaps and raises the bar for P2P performance across Sunrise. YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Own the OutcomeBe the expert who resolves what standard process can't – across PR/PO queries, invoice issues, vendor cases and time-critical escalations. Coordinate directly with Finance, Procurement and Business where needed, maintain full stakeholder visibility and close every case compliantly within SLA
- Set the Quality BarValidate purchase requisitions end-to-end – contract alignment, commodity classification, policy compliance, approval routing – and drive clean PO conversion. Apply the same rigour to vendor onboarding: validate the business case, ensure correct Ariba setup and direct all spend to the right buying channel, including SG&A and Consultancy via Consulting Requisitions (ConReq)
- Fix It for GoodDon't just resolve today's issue, identify the pattern behind it. Translate recurring P2P problems into structured improvement initiatives that feed directly into the P2P Improvement Programme and make the process permanently better
- Build Capability, Not DependencyMaintain accurate master data (pricing, catalogues, payment terms, commodity codes) as the foundation for friction-free purchasing and invoice processing. Train and coach business units on the Spend Policy, so they do it right the first time, every time. Champion catalogues, contracts and Purchase Orders to drive compliant buying behaviour at source
- Measure What MattersTrack operational KPIs (STIP – Straight-Through-Invoice-Processing, Invoice compliance, Purchase Order compliance, Vendor onboarding time), report non-compliance trends and flag Category Strategy deviations to the responsible Category Manager – turning data into accountability

YOUR SKILLS:

- Minimum 5 years of hands-on procurement or P2P operations experience in a mid-to-large enterprise, with a track record of managing complex, high-volume transactional environments
- Proficient in SAP S/4HANA; working knowledge of SAP Ariba (Buying, Sourcing or Contracts modules) is a strong advantage
- Solid grasp of end-to-end P2P processes, purchase policy frameworks, escalation management and vendor onboarding – including the ability to distinguish what needs to be resolved vs. what needs to be redesigned
- Analytical mindset: you read case data, identify patterns and translate operational KPIs into concrete improvement actions
- Skilled communicator who can de-escalate urgent situations, influence behaviour without formal authority and engage confidently with senior stakeholders
- Professional procurement/ IT certification is an advantage
- Fluent English and strong German language skills, both written and spoken

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together.

Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value.

Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future!

jobs.description:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

Join Our Team as a Customer Experience Manager! Are you passionate about enhancing customer satisfaction and driving excellence? In this pivotal role, you will elevate our customer experience by mapping the end-to-end journey, redesigning and implementing innovative processes, ensuring operational readiness, and spreading the customer’s voice within our organization. Apply now and be part of our Customer Journey Excellence team, as part of Flanker Brands organization! YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Define Requirements: Utilize Agile or Waterfall methodologies to map user journeys, identify journey gaps, define project requirements, and lead operational readiness. Translate complex information into clear, written requirements for both technical and non-technical audiences
- Documentation and Analysis: Review, analyze, and create detailed documentation for business rules and work instructions for our agents. Collaborate with key stakeholders to refine agent training and customer’s communication. Create business cases and deep data analysis to identify customer’s needs and measure the post go live effect of our activities
- Customer Service SPOC: Serve as the primary contact for Customer Service topics, offering guidance on requirement coverage, processes, and customer experience impacts. Facilitate, negotiate, and mediate between technical and business teams to ensure decisions, enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency
- Customer Advocacy: Represent the customer's voice within Flanker Brands to continuously improve customer satisfaction
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with core team members, including Product Managers, Business PMs, IT PMs, trainers, developers, and testers
- Go live Support: Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and business validations to ensure solutions meet business needs and customer expectations

YOUR SKILLS:

- At least 3 years of experience in Business Analysis or Process/Project Management, preferably within telecommunications
- Experience working with Agile and/or Waterfall methodologies
- Strong focus on customer experience and process improvement with a digital-first mindset
- Analytical thinker with a proactive, solution-oriented approach and the ability to adapt to changing business needs
- Ability to manage shifting priorities and adapt to evolving directions
- Excellent communication, storytelling, interpersonal, teamwork, and organizational skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business audiences effectively

jobs.description:
Bei Sunrise denken wir grösser, gehen weiter und schaffen Neues. Für uns bedeutet Arbeitskultur: gemeinsam Grosses schaffen. Hier treffen Respekt und frische Ideen auf echtes Teamwork – jede Stimme zählt, jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, Neues zu wagen und ständig zu wachsen. Unsere Front-Line-Heroes sind das Aushängeschild von Sunrise. Sie punkten mit massgeschneiderten Lösungen und Top-Service - so wird aus jedem Kundenkontakt eine langfristige Connection.

DEINE CHALLENGE:

- Du bist das Gesicht von Sunrise und begeisterst unsere Kundschaft mit deiner positiven Ausstrahlung, deiner zielgerichteten Beratung und dem Verkauf unserer vielfältigen Sunrise Produkte.
- Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und sorgst für eine erstklassige Atmosphäre im Shop.
- Du unterstützt Kundinnen und Kunden bei Reparatur- und Serviceanliegen und agierst dabei professionell und lösungsorientiert.
- Du behältst den Überblick über Lager und Inventur und erledigst administrative Aufgaben effizient.
- Du lebst und repräsentierst die Sunrise Werte – Innovation, Kundennähe und Top-Service.

DEINE SKILLS:

- Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Detailhandel, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in der Telekommunikations- oder Multimediabranche – oder du bist ein/e motivierte/r Quereinsteiger/-in mit Verkaufsflair.
- Du sprudelst vor Begeisterung für Technologie, Telekommunikation und digitale Trends.
- Deine Leidenschaft für den Verkauf ist spürbar und dein professionelles Auftreten machen dich zu einem echten Sales-Profi.
- Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und die Fähigkeit, ihre Bedürfnisse schnell zu erkennen.
- Dank deiner Geduld und deinem technischen Verständnis wirst du ein/e Alltagsheld/-in für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden.
- Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus.

Hier treffen Respekt und frische Ideen auf echtes Teamwork – jede Stimme zählt, jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, Neues zu wagen und ständig zu wachsen. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Verantwortung für alle MySports IT- & OTT-Systeme und stellst sicher, dass diese für den operativen Betrieb reibungslos funktionieren. Zudem verantwortest du die Weiterentwicklung unserer gesamten Systemlandschaft.

Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle zwischen Business, Streaming-Technologie, App-Entwicklung, CRM und Broadcast und sorgst dafür, dass alle Systeme optimal zusammenspielen. DEINE CHALLENGE:

- Technische Verantwortung & Betrieb:Sicherstellung eines stabilen und reibungslosen Betriebs der MySports App und aller angebundenen Systeme inkl. Monitoring der Systemperformance sowie proaktive Identifikation und Eskalation von Issues (insbesondere bei Live-Events)
- Systemintegration & Datenflüsse:Verantwortung für das Zusammenspiel der gesamten Systemlandschaft sowie Sicherstellung sauberer Datenflüsse zwischen App, CRM und Backend-Systemen inkl. Schnittstellenverantwortung zur OTT-Plattform sowie zu Broadcast-, Content- und EPG-Systemen
- Solution Design & Requirements Engineering:Übersetzung von Business-Anforderungen in klare, umsetzbare technische Requirements sowie Sicherstellung einer strukturierten und vollständigen Anforderungsdefinition
- Vendor Setup & Steuerung:Federführende Auswahl sowie Koordination und Steuerung externer Technologiepartner und Lieferanten (z. B. App, CRM, Payment, Analytics) in Abstimmung mit Procurement, Legal und Security
- Implementation & Delivery Management:End-to-End Verantwortung für die Einführung, Integration und Weiterentwicklung von Systemen und Features inkl. Planung, Koordination und Durchführung von Testing (inkl. UAT) bis zum erfolgreichen Go-Live
- Go-Live & Operational Handover:Übergabe neuer Systeme und Features an Operations inkl. Dokumentation sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen Betriebs und Begleitung der initialen Betriebsphase
- Weiterentwicklung & Optimierung:Verantwortung für die Gesamtübersicht der Systemlandschaft inkl. Identifikation von Optimierungsbedarf, Definition und kontinuierliche Optimierung von technischen Prozessen sowie Evaluation neuer Technologien (z. B. im Bereich OTT, Automatisierung, AI)

DEINE SKILLS:

- Erfahrung in einer technischen Produktmanager-, Plattform- oder System-Integrationsrolle
- Gutes Verständnis von OTT-/Streaming-Plattformen; Verständnis von digitalen Subscription-Modellen von Vorteil
- Erfahrung im Umgang mit APIs & Systemintegrationen sowie CRM-, Payment- oder Analytics-Systemen
- Grundverständnis von Datenstrukturen, Datenflüssen sowie Software-Development-Prozessen (Agile, Releases, Testing)
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Requirements Engineering inkl. Priorisierung und Stakeholder-Management
- Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Themen verständlich zu vermitteln
- Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein („Ownership“) sowie proaktive und hands-on Mentalität
- Fähigkeit, verschiedene Stakeholder (Business, Tech, externe Partner) zu koordinieren
- Interesse an neuen Technologien (insb. OTT, CRM, Automatisierung, AI)
- Sehr gute Deutsch- sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Bei Sunrise arbeitest du in einem dynamischen und multinationalen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört, Perspektiven geteilt und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Grosses.

Sunrise ist Partner von «Advance Gender Equality in Business», Träger des Schweizer LGBTI-Labels und mit «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» für die gleiche Bezahlung gleichwertiger Arbeit für alle zertifiziert.

Bist du bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann werde Teil des Teams und gestalte aktiv unsere Zukunft!

Hier treffen Respekt und frische Ideen auf echtes Teamwork – jede Stimme zählt, jede Perspektive macht uns stärker. Unsere Leidenschaft treibt uns an, Neues zu wagen und ständig zu wachsen. Klingt nach dir? Dann werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte.

Unsere Front-Line-Heroes sind das Aushängeschild von Sunrise. Sie punkten mit massgeschneiderten Lösungen und Top-Service - so wird aus jedem Kundenkontakt eine langfristige Connection.

DEINE CHALLENGE:

- Du bist das Gesicht von Sunrise und begeisterst unsere Kundschaft mit deiner positiven Ausstrahlung, deiner zielgerichteten Beratung und dem Verkauf unserer vielfältigen Sunrise Produkte.
- Du baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf und sorgst für eine erstklassige Atmosphäre im Shop.
- Du unterstützt Kundinnen und Kunden bei Reparatur- und Serviceanliegen und agierst dabei professionell und lösungsorientiert.
- Du behältst den Überblick über Lager und Inventur und erledigst administrative Aufgaben effizient.
- Du lebst und repräsentierst die Sunrise Werte – Innovation, Kundennähe und Top-Service.

DEINE SKILLS:

- Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Detailhandel, idealerweise mit Erfahrung in der Telekommunikations- oder Multimediabranche – oder du bist ein/e motivierte/r Quereinsteiger/-in mit Verkaufsflair.
- Du sprudelst vor Begeisterung für Technologie, Telekommunikation und digitale Trends.
- Deine Leidenschaft für den Verkauf ist spürbar und dein professionelles Auftreten machen dich zu einem echten Sales-Profi.
- Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und die Fähigkeit, ihre Bedürfnisse schnell zu erkennen.
- Dank deiner Geduld und deinem technischen Verständnis wirst du ein/e Alltagsheld/-in für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden.
- Du bringst die nötige Flexibilität mit, um im Schichtbetrieb in einem Shop zu arbeiten, der an sieben Tagen pro Woche geöffnet ist – dazu gehören regelmässige Abend- und Wochenendeinsätze.
- Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus.

Bei Sunrise arbeitest du in einem dynamischen und multinationalen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört, Perspektiven geteilt und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Grosses. Sunrise ist Partner von «Advance Gender Equality in Business», Träger des Schweizer LGBTI-Labels und mit «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» für die gleiche Bezahlung gleichwertiger Arbeit für alle zertifiziert.

Bist du bereit für die Herausforderung? Dann werde Teil des Teams und gestalte aktiv unsere Zukunft!

#ChallengersWanted

Hinweis für Agenturen: Bewerbungsunterlagen, die von Vermittlungsagenturen oder ähnlichen Stellen eingesandt oder hochgeladen werden, sind nicht erwünscht und werden daher nicht berücksichtigt und gelöscht.

#LI-TW1

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Noi di Sunrise Pensi in grande, andiamo oltre e creiamo cose nuove. Per noi cultura del lavoro significa: realizzare grandi cose insieme. Quio rispetto e idee nuove incontro un lavoro di squadra: ogni voce conta, ogni prospettiva ci rende più forti. La nostra passione ci spinge a provare cose nuove e a crescere. Sembri te? Allora parte diventa della nostra storia di successo. I nostri eroi in prima linea sono i fiori all’occhiello di Sunrise. Guadagnano punti con soluzioni su misura e un servizio eccellente, così ogni contatto con il cliente diventa una connessione a lungo termine. Mansioni - Be il volto di Sunrise e ispiri i nostri clienti con il tuo carisma positivo, i tuoi consigli mirati e la vendita dei nostri diversi prodotti Sunrise. - Costruisci rapporti a lungo termine con i clienti e garantisci un'atmosfera di prima classe nel negozio. - Supporti i clienti con problemi di riparazione e assistenza e agisci in modo professionale e orientale alla soluzione. - Tieni traccia del magazzino e dell'inventario e svolgi le attività amministrative in modo efficiente. - Vivi e rappresentai i valori Sunrise: innovazione, vicinanza al cliente e servizio eccellente.
• Requisiti - Hai completato la formazione nel settore della vendita al dettaglio, idealmente con esperienza nel settore delle telecomunicazioni o multimediale - oppure è un motivato al cambio di carriera con talento per la vendita. - No Essere traboccante di entusiasmo per la tecnologia, le telecomunicazioni e le tendenze digitali. - La tua passione per le vendite è evidente e il tuo comportamento professionale render un vero professionista delle vendite. - Ti piace avere a che fare con le persone e hai la capacità di riconoscere rapidamente i loro occhi. - Grazie alla tua pazienza e comprensione tecnica, nascerai un quotidiano per i nostri clienti. - Hai la flessibilità necessaria per lavorare a turni in un negozio aperto sette giorni su sette, inclusi turni serali e nei fine settimana regolari. - Hai un'ottima conoscenza del tedesco, qualsiasi lingua aggiuntiva è un vantaggio.
• Cosa? In Sunrise lavorerai in un ambiente intermedio e multinazionale dove ogni voce viene ascoltata, le prospettive successive e i valori vengono vissuti. Per noi la diversità non è solo un programma, ma parte del nostro DNA. Di protagonista preferito le nostre differenze, idea reali grandi cose insieme. Sunrise è partner di “Advance Gender Equality in Business”, titolare del marchio svizzero LGBTI e certificata con “Fair-ON-Pay Advanced” per la parità di retribuzione per un lavoro di uguale valore per tutti. Sei pronto per la sfida? Allora entra a far parte del team e plasma attivamente il nostro futuro! #ChallengersWanted Contatto Nota per le agenzie: i documenti di candidatura o caricati da agenzie di collocamento o simili non sono desiderati e quindi non verranno presi in considerazione e verranno eliminati. #LI-TW1 #
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description At Sunrise, you think big, we go further and create new things. For us work culture means: achieving great things together. here is true respect and new ideas meet teamwork: every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion drives us to try new things and grow. Does it sound like you? Then it becomes part of our success story. Our frontline heroes are the flagships of Sunrise. They earn points with tailor-made solutions and excellent service, so every customer contact becomes a long-term connection. Duties - You are the face of Sunrise and inspire our customers with your positive charisma, targeted advice and sales of our different Sunrise products. - Build long-term relationships with customers and ensure a first-class atmosphere in the store. - You support customers with repair and service issues and act in a professional and solution-oriented manner. - Track your warehouse and inventory and carry out administrative tasks efficiently. - Live and represent the Sunrise values: innovation, customer proximity and excellent service.
• Requirements - You have completed training in the retail sector, ideally with experience in the telecommunications or multimedia sector - or are a motivated career changer with a knack for selling. - No Be overflowing with enthusiasm for technology, telecommunications and digital trends. - Your passion for sales is evident and your professional demeanor will make you a true sales professional. - You enjoy dealing with people and have the ability to quickly recognize their eyes. - Thanks to your patience and technical understanding, you will create a newspaper for our customers. - You have the flexibility to work shifts in a store that is open seven days a week, including regular evening and weekend shifts. - You have excellent knowledge of German, any additional language is a plus.
• What we offer At Sunrise you will work in an intermediary, multinational environment where every voice is heard, subsequent perspectives and values ​​are lived. For us, diversity is not just a program, but part of our DNA. Favorite protagonist our differences, real idea of ​​great things together. Sunrise is a partner of “Advance Gender Equality in Business”, owner of the Swiss LGBTI brand and certified with “Fair-ON-Pay Advanced” for equal pay for work of equal value for all. Are you ready for the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future! #ChallengersWanted Contact Note to agencies: Application documents or documents uploaded by employment agencies or similar are unwanted and will therefore not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-TW1 #

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description Chez Sunrise, vous voyez grand, nous allons plus loin et créons de nouvelles choses. Pour nous, la culture du travail signifie : réaliser de grandes choses ensemble. ici, c'est le vrai respect et les nouvelles idées rencontrent le travail d'équipe : chaque voix compte, chaque perspective nous rend plus forts. Notre passion nous pousse à essayer de nouvelles choses et à grandir. Est-ce que ça vous ressemble ? Cela fait alors partie de notre histoire à succès. Nos héros de première ligne sont les fleurons de Sunrise. Ils gagnent des points grâce à des solutions sur mesure et à un excellent service, de sorte que chaque contact client devient une connexion à long terme. Fonctions - Vous êtes le visage de Sunrise et inspirez nos clients par votre charisme positif, vos conseils ciblés et la vente de nos différents produits Sunrise. - Établir des relations à long terme avec les clients et assurer une atmosphère de première classe dans le magasin. - Vous assistez les clients avec des problèmes de réparation et de service et agissez de manière professionnelle et orientée vers les solutions. - Suivez votre entrepôt et votre inventaire et effectuez les tâches administratives efficacement. - Vivre et représenter les valeurs de Sunrise : innovation, proximité client et excellent service.
• Exigences - Vous avez suivi une formation dans le secteur de la vente au détail, idéalement avec une expérience dans le secteur des télécommunications ou du multimédia - ou êtes un réorienteur de carrière motivé et doué pour la vente. - Non Être débordant d'enthousiasme pour les tendances technologiques, de télécommunications et numériques. - Votre passion pour la vente est évidente et votre attitude professionnelle fera de vous un véritable professionnel de la vente. - Vous aimez traiter avec les gens et avez la capacité de reconnaître rapidement leurs yeux. - Grâce à votre patience et votre compréhension technique, vous créerez un journal pour nos clients. - Vous avez la flexibilité de travailler par quarts dans un magasin ouvert sept jours sur sept, y compris les quarts réguliers de soir et de fin de semaine. - Vous avez une excellente connaissance de l'allemand, toute langue supplémentaire est un plus. Ce que nous proposons Chez Sunrise, vous travaillerez dans un environnement intermédiaire et multinational où chaque voix est entendue, les perspectives et les valeurs ultérieures sont vécues. Pour nous, la diversité n’est pas seulement un programme, mais fait partie de notre ADN. Protagoniste préféré de nos différences, véritable idée de grandes choses ensemble. Sunrise est partenaire de « Advance Gender Equality in Business », propriétaire de la marque suisse LGBTI et certifié « Fair-ON-Pay Advanced » pour un salaire égal pour un travail de valeur égale pour tous. Êtes-vous prêt à relever le défi ? Alors rejoignez l’équipe et façonnez activement notre avenir ! #ChallengersWanted Contact Note aux agences : Les documents de candidature ou les documents téléchargés par les agences pour l'emploi ou similaires ne sont pas désirés et ne seront donc pas pris en compte et seront supprimés. #LI-TW1 #

jobs.title: Marketing Retention Manager 80-100%
jobs.description:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

As the B2B Prevention & Retention Manager, you are responsible for proactively identifying at-risk customers and deploying targeted retention strategies and campaigns, with special offers to reduce churn. You will leverage data insights, customer behavior, and close collaboration with B2B Frontline Retention, Base Management, Analytics, and NPS teams to drive retention initiatives, ensuring long-term customer satisfaction and value.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Churn Prevention Strategy – Identify customers with a high risk of churn through data analysis and implement tailored retention campaigns
- Churn Prevention Execution – Conduct briefings, listen in on customer calls, evaluate customer escalations as needed, ensure the quality of the operational campaign. Design, evaluate, and execute special offers and incentives that align with customer needs and company goals
- Customer Segmentation – Develop segmentation strategies to personalize prevention actions and increase offer relevance and effectiveness
- Performance Monitoring – Track the impact of prevention activities and offers; continuously refine strategies based on KPIs and feedback
- Cross-functional Collaboration – Work closely with Base Management, Retention Frontline, NPS Team and Marketing to align retention tactics, share customer insights and solve customer interactions.
- Customer Insights & Reporting – Analyze customer feedback, usage trends, and churn reasons to support data-driven decision-making
- Process Optimization – Continuously improve churn prevention workflows, tools, and automation for scalability and efficiency

YOUR SKILLS:

- Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field
- Proven experience (3+ years) in customer retention, Base Management, Value Management, or related field
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data and customer behavior patterns
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with a customer-centric mindset
- Ability to work cross-functionally and drive initiatives in a fast-paced environment
- Strategic thinker with hands-on execution ability and a proactive approach to problem-solving
- Fluent in German and English, Italian and French is a plus

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together.

Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value.

Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future!

- Du bist das Gesicht von Sunrise und begeisterst unsere Kundschaft mit deiner positiven Ausstrahlung, deiner zielgerichteten Beratung und dem Verkauf unserer vielfältigen Sunrise Produkte.

- Du behältst den Überblick über Lager und Inventur und erledigst administrative Aufgaben effizient.

DEINE SKILLS:

- Du sprudelst vor Begeisterung für Technologie, Telekommunikation und digitale Trends.
- Deine Leidenschaft für den Verkauf ist spürbar und dein professionelles Auftreten machen dich zu einem echten Sales-Profi.
- Du hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen und die Fähigkeit, ihre Bedürfnisse schnell zu erkennen.
- Dank deiner Geduld und deinem technischen Verständnis wirst du ein/e Alltagsheld/-in für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden.
- Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, jede weitere Sprache ist ein Plus.
- Du bringst eine grosse Portion Flexibilität, Zuverlässigkeit und Offenheit für eine schnelllebige Branche mit.

Bei Sunrise arbeitest du in einem dynamischen und multinationalen Umfeld, in dem jede Stimme gehört, Perspektiven geteilt und Werte gelebt werden. Vielfalt ist für uns nicht nur ein Programm, sondern Teil unserer DNA. Weil wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Grosses.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineer & MLOps 80-100%
jobs.description:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

At ADAO (AI, Data and Agentic Enablement Office), we bring people together to unlock the future of Sunrise through data, analytics, AI, and agentic technologies. We think big, move with purpose, and turn ideas into real impact for our customers and teams. ADAO is where innovation meets trust: we build strong data foundations, scale safe and reliable AI capabilities, and empower business units through a hub‑and‑spoke operating model to deliver meaningful results across the company. Within this model, you will work as part of the Agentic Enablement and Prompt Engineering & Conversation Design team, where the central hub provides standards, platforms, architecture, and best practices, while cross‑functional, outcome‑driven Pods are embedded in and led by the business. You will act as an engineering expert, partnering closely with the business to deliver on their priorities and outcomes.

In this role you will design, build, deploy and operate production grade ML and GenAI solutions, including RAG components where applicable, that deliver measurable business value for Sunrise, ensuring end-to-end lifecycle excellence from experimentation to automated deployment, monitoring, risk controls and continuous improvement in alignment with ADAO standards and governance.

You will be part of the central AI/ML Engineering & MLOps chapter within the ADAO Hub, supporting embedded Domain Pods through reusable platform components, engineering standards and hands-on delivery.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Develop & industrialize ML/GenAI solutions: Translate business roadmaps into solution designs while implementing robust training/inference pipelines and production services that meet all non‑functional requirementsCo-design solution architectures with Data Scientists and Domain Pods (batch/real-time, APIs, RAG patterns where relevant)Industrialize prototypes: automated tests, secure packaging, deployment/rollback, and performance/cost tuning
- Co-design solution architectures with Data Scientists and Domain Pods (batch/real-time, APIs, RAG patterns where relevant)
- Industrialize prototypes: automated tests, secure packaging, deployment/rollback, and performance/cost tuning

- Own & evolve MLOps/LLMOps pipelines: Build standardized CI/CD workflows, manage model promotion through dev→test→prod, and maintain monitoring and drift/retraining mechanismsMaintain standard CI/CD/CT templates incl. model/prompt packaging, validation gates, and dev→test→prod promotionOperate model registry/versioning and automated retraining triggers aligned to ADAO governance and CIO/IT change windows
- Maintain standard CI/CD/CT templates incl. model/prompt packaging, validation gates, and dev→test→prod promotion
- Operate model registry/versioning and automated retraining triggers aligned to ADAO governance and CIO/IT change windows

- Operate experimentation & feature management: Provide reproducible experimentation, manage feature store patterns and validation, and promote reusable datasets/features across PodsProvide experiment tracking, dataset/feature versioning and feature-store patterns (offline/online parity)Run evaluation harnesses for ML & GenAI (regression, A/B tests, safety & multilingual checks) and share reusable assets
- Provide experiment tracking, dataset/feature versioning and feature-store patterns (offline/online parity)
- Run evaluation harnesses for ML & GenAI (regression, A/B tests, safety & multilingual checks) and share reusable assets

- Model documentation, governance & risk: Produce compliant model documentation, implement required governance/security/privacy controls, and support GenAI safety and auditability measuresProduce model cards and compliance artefacts (data sources, limitations, privacy/bias controls) and evidence for auditsImplement Responsible AI / GenAI guardrails: grounding, HITL approvals, audit logs, and risk reviews with governance teams
- Produce model cards and compliance artefacts (data sources, limitations, privacy/bias controls) and evidence for audits
- Implement Responsible AI / GenAI guardrails: grounding, HITL approvals, audit logs, and risk reviews with governance teams

- Observability, reliability & incident response: Implement full observability for models and services, maintain runbooks and alerting, participate in incident resolution, and drive reliability improvementsDefine SLOs/SLIs and implement monitoring/alerting for quality, drift, latency, availability and costMaintain runbooks, participate in on-call/incident postmortems, and drive corrective actions
- Define SLOs/SLIs and implement monitoring/alerting for quality, drift, latency, availability and cost
- Maintain runbooks, participate in on-call/incident postmortems, and drive corrective actions

- Enablement & reusable components: Provide reusable ML/GenAI components, coach teams on MLOps/LLMOps best practices and ensure consistent engineering standards across Hub and PodsBuild reusable libraries and reference implementations (RAG connectors, evaluation utilities, deployment scaffolding)Coach Pod engineers through reviews, pairing and clinics; contribute to ADAO AI Academy materials
- Build reusable libraries and reference implementations (RAG connectors, evaluation utilities, deployment scaffolding)
- Coach Pod engineers through reviews, pairing and clinics; contribute to ADAO AI Academy materials

- Key deliverables (illustrative):Standard ML/LLMOps pipeline template + reference architectures (batch/real-time/RAG)Model registry & artefact versioning (models, prompts, datasets, features)Monitoring dashboards + drift detection + SLO reportingGenAI evaluation test suite (regression, safety, multilingual) and acceptance thresholdsModel documentation pack and operational runbooks (audit-ready)
- Standard ML/LLMOps pipeline template + reference architectures (batch/real-time/RAG)
- Model registry & artefact versioning (models, prompts, datasets, features)
- Monitoring dashboards + drift detection + SLO reporting
- GenAI evaluation test suite (regression, safety, multilingual) and acceptance thresholds
- Model documentation pack and operational runbooks (audit-ready)

YOUR SKILLS:

- Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience
- 3+ years in ML engineering, MLOps, software/data engineering or related roles, with proven end-to-end production of ML/GenAI solutions
- Hands‑on CI/CD and DevOps for ML workloads (testing, version control, release management), plus IaC (Terraform/Pulumi) and GitOps
- Experience with ML frameworks (scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) and serving patterns (REST/gRPC, batch, streaming), and MLOps tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, Vertex AI, SageMaker)
- Strong Python software engineering (testing, APIs), containers (Docker) and cloud deployment patterns; GenAI/RAG experience is a plus
- Familiarity with feature stores, experiment tracking, data quality testing and orchestration tools (Airflow/Dagster/Prefect), working in cross-functional Hub and Pod setups
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, ownership mindset and reliability under pressure with a structured engineering approach
- Ability to influence without formal authority, champion standards across Hub and Pods, and continuously adapt to evolving AI/ML technologies; telecommunications experience is a plus

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together. Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value. Ready to rise to the challenge? At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

At ADAO (AI, Data and Agentic Enablement Office), we bring people together to unlock the future of Sunrise through data, analytics, AI, and agentic technologies. We think big, move with purpose, and turn ideas into real impact for our customers and teams. ADAO is where innovation meets trust: we build strong data foundations, scale safe and reliable AI capabilities, and empower business units through a hub‑and‑spoke operating model to deliver meaningful results across the company. Within this model, you will work as part of the Agentic Enablement and Prompt Engineering & Conversation Design team, where the central hub provides standards, platforms, architecture, and best practices, while cross‑functional, outcome‑driven Pods are embedded in and led by the business. You will act as an engineering expert, partnering closely with the business to deliver on their priorities and outcomes.

In this role you will design, build, deploy and operate production grade ML and GenAI solutions, including RAG components where applicable, that deliver measurable business value for Sunrise, ensuring end-to-end lifecycle excellence from experimentation to automated deployment, monitoring, risk controls and continuous improvement in alignment with ADAO standards and governance.

You will be part of the central AI/ML Engineering & MLOps chapter within the ADAO Hub, supporting embedded Domain Pods through reusable platform components, engineering standards and hands-on delivery.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Develop & industrialize ML/GenAI solutions: Translate business roadmaps into solution designs while implementing robust training/inference pipelines and production services that meet all non‑functional requirementsCo-design solution architectures with Data Scientists and Domain Pods (batch/real-time, APIs, RAG patterns where relevant)Industrialize prototypes: automated tests, secure packaging, deployment/rollback, and performance/cost tuning
- Co-design solution architectures with Data Scientists and Domain Pods (batch/real-time, APIs, RAG patterns where relevant)
- Industrialize prototypes: automated tests, secure packaging, deployment/rollback, and performance/cost tuning

- Own & evolve MLOps/LLMOps pipelines: Build standardized CI/CD workflows, manage model promotion through dev→test→prod, and maintain monitoring and drift/retraining mechanismsMaintain standard CI/CD/CT templates incl. model/prompt packaging, validation gates, and dev→test→prod promotionOperate model registry/versioning and automated retraining triggers aligned to ADAO governance and CIO/IT change windows
- Maintain standard CI/CD/CT templates incl. model/prompt packaging, validation gates, and dev→test→prod promotion
- Operate model registry/versioning and automated retraining triggers aligned to ADAO governance and CIO/IT change windows

- Operate experimentation & feature management: Provide reproducible experimentation, manage feature store patterns and validation, and promote reusable datasets/features across PodsProvide experiment tracking, dataset/feature versioning and feature-store patterns (offline/online parity)Run evaluation harnesses for ML & GenAI (regression, A/B tests, safety & multilingual checks) and share reusable assets
- Provide experiment tracking, dataset/feature versioning and feature-store patterns (offline/online parity)
- Run evaluation harnesses for ML & GenAI (regression, A/B tests, safety & multilingual checks) and share reusable assets

- Model documentation, governance & risk: Produce compliant model documentation, implement required governance/security/privacy controls, and support GenAI safety and auditability measuresProduce model cards and compliance artefacts (data sources, limitations, privacy/bias controls) and evidence for auditsImplement Responsible AI / GenAI guardrails: grounding, HITL approvals, audit logs, and risk reviews with governance teams
- Produce model cards and compliance artefacts (data sources, limitations, privacy/bias controls) and evidence for audits
- Implement Responsible AI / GenAI guardrails: grounding, HITL approvals, audit logs, and risk reviews with governance teams

- Observability, reliability & incident response: Implement full observability for models and services, maintain runbooks and alerting, participate in incident resolution, and drive reliability improvementsDefine SLOs/SLIs and implement monitoring/alerting for quality, drift, latency, availability and costMaintain runbooks, participate in on-call/incident postmortems, and drive corrective actions
- Define SLOs/SLIs and implement monitoring/alerting for quality, drift, latency, availability and cost
- Maintain runbooks, participate in on-call/incident postmortems, and drive corrective actions

- Enablement & reusable components: Provide reusable ML/GenAI components, coach teams on MLOps/LLMOps best practices and ensure consistent engineering standards across Hub and PodsBuild reusable libraries and reference implementations (RAG connectors, evaluation utilities, deployment scaffolding)Coach Pod engineers through reviews, pairing and clinics; contribute to ADAO AI Academy materials
- Build reusable libraries and reference implementations (RAG connectors, evaluation utilities, deployment scaffolding)
- Coach Pod engineers through reviews, pairing and clinics; contribute to ADAO AI Academy materials

- Key deliverables (illustrative):Standard ML/LLMOps pipeline template + reference architectures (batch/real-time/RAG)Model registry & artefact versioning (models, prompts, datasets, features)Monitoring dashboards + drift detection + SLO reportingGenAI evaluation test suite (regression, safety, multilingual) and acceptance thresholdsModel documentation pack and operational runbooks (audit-ready)
- Standard ML/LLMOps pipeline template + reference architectures (batch/real-time/RAG)
- Model registry & artefact versioning (models, prompts, datasets, features)
- Monitoring dashboards + drift detection + SLO reporting
- GenAI evaluation test suite (regression, safety, multilingual) and acceptance thresholds
- Model documentation pack and operational runbooks (audit-ready)

YOUR SKILLS:

- Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience
- 3+ years in ML engineering, MLOps, software/data engineering or related roles, with proven end-to-end production of ML/GenAI solutions
- Hands‑on CI/CD and DevOps for ML workloads (testing, version control, release management), plus IaC (Terraform/Pulumi) and GitOps
- Experience with ML frameworks (scikit‑learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow) and serving patterns (REST/gRPC, batch, streaming), and MLOps tooling (MLflow, Kubeflow, Azure ML, Vertex AI, SageMaker)

Ici le respect et les idées nouvelles rencontrent un véritable travail d'équipe – chaque voix compte, chaque perspective nous rend plus forts. Notre passion nous pousse à oser de nouvelles choses et à grandir constamment. Vous ressemblez ? Puis faites partie de notre histoire de réussite.

Nos héros de première ligne sont le fleuron de Sunrise. Vous marquez avec des solutions personnalisées et un service haut de gamme - donc chaque contact client devient une connexion à long terme.

Votre défi :

- Vous êtes le visage de Sunrise et inspirez nos clients avec votre charisme positif, vos conseils ciblés et la vente de nos divers produits Sunrise.
- Vous construisez des relations client à long terme et offrez une atmosphère de première classe dans le magasin.
- Vous aidez les clients avec des préoccupations de réparation et de service et agissez de manière professionnelle et orientée vers la solution.
- Vous gardez une trace des stocks et des stocks et effectuez des tâches administratives efficacement.
- Vous vivez et représentez les valeurs de Sunrise – innovation, proximité client et service haut de gamme.

Vos meurtres :

- Vous avez terminé un apprentissage dans le commerce de détail, idéalement avec l'expérience dans l'industrie des télécommunications ou multimédia – ou vous êtes un entrant latéral motivé avec un style de vente.
- Avec enthousiasme pour la technologie, les télécommunications et les tendances numériques.
- Votre passion pour les ventes est perceptible et votre apparence professionnelle vous fait un vrai professionnel des ventes.
- Vous aimez traiter avec les gens et la capacité de reconnaître rapidement leurs besoins.
- Grâce à votre patience et à votre compréhension technique, vous deviendrez un héros quotidien pour nos clients.
- Vous avez une très bonne connaissance de l'allemand, toutes les autres langues sont un plus.
- Vous apportez beaucoup de flexibilité, de fiabilité et d'ouverture à une industrie en évolution rapide.

À Sunrise, vous travaillez dans un environnement dynamique et multinational où chaque voix est entendue, les perspectives sont partagées et les valeurs sont vécues. La diversité n'est pas seulement un programme pour nous, mais une partie de notre ADN. Parce que nous célébrons nos différences, nous accomplissons de grandes choses ensemble.

Sunrise est partenaire d'Advance Gender Equality in Business, label suisse LGBTI et certifié par Fair-ON-Pay Advanced pour un salaire égal pour un travail de valeur égale pour tous.

Êtes-vous prêt pour le défi? Faites ensuite partie de l'équipe et façonnez activement notre avenir !

#Challengeurs Wanted

jobs.title: Lead Generation Specialist B2B 50%
jobs.description:
At Sunrise, we think bigger, go further and create new ideas. For us working culture means achieving great things together. It’s where respect and innovative ideas combine with real teamwork – every voice counts, every perspective makes us stronger. Our passion spurs us on to try new things and grow continuously. Sound like you? Then join our success story.

As a Lead Generation Specialist, you identify and acquire qualified business contacts. With your strong understanding of B2B markets, your data-driven approach, and your excellent communication skills, you unlock new sales potential and actively contribute to the sustainable growth of our company.

YOUR CHALLENGE:

- Identify and proactively approach potential business customers
- Develop and implement lead generation strategies and prepare qualified contacts
- Schedule appointments and hand them over to the sales team
- Develop tailored solutions based on customer needs
- Build and maintain long-term customer relationships
- Collaborate closely with the marketing team to execute sales campaigns
- Use CRM and analytics tools to optimize and streamline processes

YOUR SKILLS:

- Experience in sales, telemarketing, or B2B lead generation
- Strong communication and negotiation skills
- Proficiency in using CRM systems and digital sales tools
- Independent, structured, and goal-oriented working style
- Analytical thinking and strong problem-solving abilities
- Team-oriented with a high level of assertiveness
- Very good German skills and good English skills, both written and spoken

At Sunrise, you’ll be working in a dynamic and multinational environment where every voice is heard, perspectives are shared and values are lived. Diversity isn’t just a program for us, it’s part of our DNA. By celebrating our differences, we achieve great things together.

Sunrise has partnered with «Advance – Gender Equality in Business». We’ve also been awarded the Swiss LGBTI label and «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced» certification as recognition for offering all our employees equal pay for work of equal value.

Ready to rise to the challenge? Then join the team and actively shape our future!

#ChallengersWanted

Information for agencies: Application dossiers sent or uploaded by placement agencies or similar are not desired, will therefore not be considered and will be deleted. #LI-ST1

Vielfalt ist nicht nur ein Programm für uns, sie ist Teil unserer DNA. Indem wir unsere Unterschiede feiern, erreichen wir gemeinsam Großes. Sunrise ist eine Partnerschaft mit «Advance – Gender Equality in Business» eingegangen. Wir haben auch das Schweizer LGBTI-Label und die «Fair-ON-Pay Advanced»-Zertifizierung als Anerkennung dafür erhalten, dass wir allen unseren Mitarbeitern die gleiche Bezahlung für gleichwertige Arbeit bieten. Bereit, sich der Herausforderung zu stellen? Dann treten Sie dem Team bei und gestalten Sie aktiv unsere Zukunft! #ChallengersWanted Information für Agenturen: Bewerbungsdossiers, die von Vermittlungsagenturen oder ähnlichem gesendet oder hochgeladen werden, sind nicht erwünscht, werden daher nicht berücksichtigt und werden gelöscht. #LI-ST1
